description: This file defines Discord voice channel commands (join, leave, status) for a bot, including authorization and runtime context handling.

classes.name: JoinCommand
classes.description: Command to join a specified voice channel.

classes.name: LeaveCommand
classes.description: Command to leave the current voice channel.

classes.name: StatusCommand
classes.description: Command to display current voice sessions.

classes.name: CommandWithSubcommands
classes.description: Base class for commands with subcommands.

methods.name: authorizeVoiceCommand
methods.description: Handles authorization logic for voice commands based on interaction and context.

methods.name: resolveVoiceCommandRuntimeContext
methods.description: Resolves runtime context including guild ID and voice manager.

methods.name: ensureVoiceCommandAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to execute voice commands.

methods.name: createDiscordVoiceCommand
methods.description: Creates the main voice command with subcommands for Discord bot.

methods.name: isVoiceChannelType
methods.description: Checks if a channel type is a voice channel type.
